description: This bar chart, titled "Average performance on November 2024 AMC 10/12 tests," illustrates the average scores achieved by two distinct model types—“Large model” (represented by light blue bars) and “Small model” (represented by dark blue bars)—across a series of different AI models. The horizontal axis lists the specific models tested, including “70b” (a partially obscured label), “Claude 3.5 Sonnet,” “Qwen 2.5 14b-instruct,” “GPT 4o,” “GPT 4o-mini,” “Qwen 2.5 72b-instruct,” “Gemini Flash 1.5,” “Gemini Pro 1.5,” and “phi-4.” The vertical axis, labeled “Average score (temperature = 0.5),” ranges from 60 to 90 on a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 10. Each bar is annotated with its corresponding average score, and error bars are present above each bar, indicating variability. The “Large model” bars are light blue, while the “Small model” bars are dark blue. The scores range from a low of 66.4 for the “70b” model to a high of 91.8 for the “phi-4” model. The chart includes a legend in the top-left corner that explicitly links the light blue color to “Large model” and the dark blue color to “Small model.” The bars are arranged in the order of the model names on the x-axis, from left to right, and are not sorted by performance. The “phi-4” model, represented by the dark blue bar, shows the highest performance with a score of 91.8, while the “70b” model, represented by the light blue bar, shows the lowest performance with a score of 66.4.
